principles: A successful deployment is not proof of user-visible behavior.
A claim status does not improve merely because it is repeated.
Each important claim retains scope, uncertainty, source and a revalidation path.

evidence.claim: The old public homepage loaded and explained that a request is pre-confirmation.
evidence.limitation: Content fetch only; not a complete browser test.

evidence.claim: The old health endpoint reported ok=true and storage=available in the previous audit.
evidence.limitation: Not proof of every write/read operation.

evidence.claim: Search API and discovery page returned 404 on the old alias after rollback.
evidence.limitation: Historical observation; re-check before any future production mutation.

evidence.claim: The previous stable deployment and latest listed deployment had different IDs.
evidence.limitation: Alias mapping must be checked before promotion.

evidence.claim: Loofy147/La9ta was empty on initial inspection; source code, tests and docs were added under Git.
evidence.limitation: Use current branch/commit for current contents.

evidence.claim: Long Vercel source responses were visibly truncated and were not treated as canonical source.
evidence.limitation: This is a clean reconstruction, not a byte-for-byte recovery.

evidence.claim: GitHub Actions La9ta CI run #38 completed successfully.
evidence.limitation: The documentation-only commit does not materially change app source; tests are domain/contracts, not a penetration test.

evidence.claim: Independent Node.js 22 run of npm run check && npm test exited 0 with all 27 tests passing.
evidence.limitation: No browser integration or persisted admin read/update in this run.

evidence.claim: A separate Vercel project la9ta is linked to Loofy147/La9ta with root directory src.
evidence.limitation: Separate from old project dz-pick-store.

evidence.claim: The documentation-updated branch deployment is READY and uses the recorded commit.
evidence.limitation: READY only establishes platform deployment state.

evidence.claim: GET /api/health reported ok=true and storage=available in the isolated project.
evidence.limitation: Health/list probe does not independently prove order retrieval.

evidence.claim: HOCO H29 search returned a relevant result with a human-facing Ouedkniss URL ending in d56373493 and observed price 900 DZD.
evidence.limitation: Price/stock still need revalidation before customer commitment.

evidence.claim: GET /api/admin-orders without x-admin-token returned HTTP 401.
evidence.limitation: Correct-token path and updates remain unverified.

evidence.claim: A valid synthetic POST /api/order returned HTTP 201 with order number DZ-C3A8D87B and priceStatus needs_revalidation.
evidence.testData: QA Synthetic; phone 0000000000; wilaya TEST-QA; catalog id 1 quantity 1
evidence.limitation: The record was written through the handler but has not been independently re-read from the authenticated admin API.

evidence.claim: Unknown catalog ID, quantity zero, and a populated honeypot each returned HTTP 422.
evidence.limitation: Additional negative cases (bad phone, oversized payload, unsupported method) can be expanded.

evidence.claim: Synthetic QA order DZ-C3A8D87B remains in the isolated preview Blob store and is not a real customer order.
evidence.limitation: Do not migrate it to production. Remove it using a trusted private maintenance path when available.

evidence.claim: An earlier browser run verified the catalog grid, catalog add, relevant HOCO H29 search, adding the discovery offer, and navigation to the request section.
evidence.limitation: It predates the final dedup fix; no customer data entered and no order form submitted in that browser run.

evidence.claim: Unit tests and static tests verify Ouedkniss URL variants normalize to a shared identity and both cart entry paths use the shared utility.
evidence.limitation: Post-fix interactive cart regression remains open.

evidence.claim: An order can be read through authenticated admin API, updated through a legal state transition and reread with status history.
evidence.limitation: Positive admin token path has not been tested; only missing-token 401 is established.

evidence.claim: La9ta is connected to a separate Vercel project; the old project/domain alias was not reassigned.
evidence.limitation: No production cutover or legacy order migration.

evidence.claim: A separate private Blob store is linked to the new project and its health endpoint reports storage available.
evidence.source: Vercel store store_rAO0bQFXBAZFzJd9 and live health response
evidence.limitation: Authenticated read/update and cleanup paths are not verified.

evidence.claim: Payment and courier integrations are operational.
evidence.limitation: No evidence of payment gateway or shipping API integration.
